blurb: Guests book a tandem skydive, meet their certified instructor, take a 10 minute airplane flight to jump height, experience a 40-60 second freefall at 120MPH, followed by a 5 minute scenic parachute flight. The whole process usually takes a few hours, budget at least 4-6 hours. Equipment is provided by Skydive Baltimore.
extraNote: weekend reservations highly recommended; weekday reservations required · Harford County Airport, Aberdeen, Maryland
